## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce
Detailed instructions on how to recreate this bug.

## Screenshots (UI bugs)
If applicable, screenshots or a short screen recording to help explain the problem.

## Logs / Traces
- If applicable, link to Sentry issue: <paste URL>.
- Stack trace or relevant log excerpt.

## Expected Outcome
- Error is resolved.
- Error is handled and logged to allow process to continue.
- Feedback is provided to the user.

## Additional context
Anything else we should know (dependencies, risks, assumptions, etc).
